full_judgment:
Mr. M. A. Aziz, J:- This appeal is directed against the order dated 4-5-2000 passed in Jananirapatta (Bishesh Bidhan) Case No. 42 of 2000 by the Janaripatta (Bishesh Bidhan) Tribunal, Dhaka Refusing to grant bail to accused appellant Bhashani @ Shirajuddin. 

 2. Allegation against the appellant is that while informant S. I. of Police Md. Shahabuddin accompanied by police force was proceeding towards Nawabpur Road by pickup Van he found the accused Sagir Rubel & Javed Kamal, Rubel, Monir Hossain, Siddique Nuru, Mohashin, Kamal Pappu, Salaudin, Ismail and Shirajuddin Bhashani (appellant), Jalal, Lahsuddin and 30/40 Unknown young men exploding bombs near Roy Saheb Bazar and thereby causing obstruction to the normal movement of passed by and vehicles. They also hurled bombs on the police on being asked by the informant, constable Rafique fired 3 rounds of gas shells. The matter was brought to the notice of the higher authority and an additional Police force was sent to the place of occurrence, whereupon the accused persons fled away by exploding bombs. The informant saw the accused persons in the street light within a short time the situation was brought under control, The informant found a person lying dead near the Dhaka Boarding at Nawabpur Road, over which a separate case has been start The above occurrence gave rise to Sutrapur P.S. Case No. 66 dated 16-2-2000 which culminates into charge sheet dated 29-3-2000 under sections 8/10/12 of the Jananirapatta (Bishesh Bidhan) 2000 against 12 accused person including the appellant. Two of the FIR named accused persons namely, Jalaluddin and Lahauddin allegedly seen by the informant in the street light were dropped from the charge sheet. 

 5. The learned Tribunal rejected the prayer for bail holding inter alia that from the F. I. R. charge sheet and other papers it appear that the appellant created terror and obstructed the movement of vehicles and passengers and thus committed offence under the Jananirpatta Ain. It is submitted that the appellant is in custody since 18-2-2000 The learned Advocate further submitted that the appellant is aged 50 years that he is the owner of a shop at Roy Shaheb Bazar, Dhaka, he is not involved in any kind of activity subversive of the state or of discipline. He has fallen a victim of circumstance; he is a loyal and law abiding citizen and if the appellant is enlarged on bail he will not abscond or in any way misuse the privilege of bail. 

 7. In the result the appeal is allowed. Let appellant Bashani alias Shirajuddin, Son of Late Oli Ahmed of 123, Nasiruddin Sarder lane, Police Station Sutrapur, Dhaka be enlarged on bail to the satisfaction of the District Magistrate, Dhaka.
